description_en: Cola Nani is located at the northern end of Bungamati. It consists of one Gaṇeśa shrine and threecaityas. The shrine was built around 1973; people brought wood from the nearby forest for its construction. Before this, the Gaṇeśa shrine stood in an open space. Leaning against the back wall, Gaṇeśa's house is supported by eight plain columns and has a hip roof covered in tiles (which local residents call Chinese tiles). The Nani is also known as Gubhāḥkhyaḥ Nani due to the fact that Gubhāḥjus and Vajrācāryas live in its vicinity. Local residents say that Bandhudatta Ācārya helped King Narendradeva and Lalita Jyāpu to bring the Red Matsyendranātha to the Kathmandu Valley, and that he lived in this Nani. The Vajrācāryas living in this area therefore believe that they are the descendants of Bandhudatta.
description_ne: अहिले यो फल्चाको रूपमा रहे पनि वास्तवमा यो कुनै फल्चा नभई गणेशको देवस्थल मात्र हो । यो देवस्थल कहिले बनाइयो भन्ने स्पष्ट पार्ने कुनै अभिलेख पाइएको छैन । विसं २०३० सालतिर सँगै रहेको कार्यविनायकको जंगलबाट काठ ल्याई स्थानीयहरूले गणेशको लागि फल्चा बनाइदिएका थिए । स्थानीय सीप र सामग्री प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस फल्चामा टायलको छाना राखिएको छ । फल्चाभित्र चार हात भएका गणेशको ढुंगाको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ ।गुभाःजु (वज्राचार्य) हरूको बाहुल्यता भएकोले यस ननिलाई गुभाःख्यः पनि भनिन्छ । राजा नरेन्द्रदेव, बन्धुदत्त आचार्य र ललित ज्यापु मिलेर रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथलाई नेपाल उपत्यकामा ल्याएको कथा प्रसिद्ध छ । रातो मच्छिन्द्रनाथलाई नेपाल उपत्यकामा ल्याएपछि बन्धुदत्त आचार्य यसै ननिमा बसोबास गरेका र यस ननिमा रहेका वज्राचार्यहरू उनकै सन्तति हुन् भनिन्छ । यस ननिभित्र गणेश फल्चा सहित तीनवटा चैत्य रहेका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)

historical_events.event_description: Śākyas from the Cola Nani constructed the Śikharakūṭacaitya(BUN0023-003) and established aguṭhīfor its management. The names of the main donors could not be deciphered due to the poor condition of the inscription. However, it appears that Namo Siṃju, Ranhāvatī, Dhanasiṃ Jyoti, Śrī Bhāgi Siṃja and others made thecaitya.
Locals made a house for the deity around 1973. They used wood from the nearby forest to construct it.
Many of the houses in the Cola Nani area collapsed in the 2015 earthquake. Thephalcā,naniand other monuments were also affected by the earthquake. People built huts in thenani.
